name: AI Driver Behaviour
author: Kizi
description: How AI drivers race and drive: gap to other cars, making room, how often they spin, how fast they react to slides and hits, damaged driving. Every driver can race differently. Experimental.

options.label: Close racing: gap to other cars
options.description: The space an AI car leaves to the cars around it, most visible when racing side by side (the game's value is 0.35). Smaller = closer, wheel to wheel. None = no space kept. The same for every car.

options.label: Close racing: when they make room
options.description: Whether an AI car gives room in a corner when another car is alongside (the game gives room at a third of a car, 0.33). Higher = it gives room later and holds its line.

options.label: Close racing: drivers differ
options.description: Gives each driver their own value around "when they make room" (up to ±0.06, ±0.12 or ±0.18), plus their own attack distance and commitment to a pass. Fixed per driver. The gap is not changed.

options.label: Slides: AI spins
options.description: One setting for how often AI cars slide and spin: exit mistakes, slide catching, traction control, lift-off, give-up angle and reaction to slides together. Custom = use the Custom spins settings.

options.label: Reaction: after a hit
options.description: After a hit the AI's steering stays put before it reacts, so the hit can turn the car. Fixed time, or scaled: 0.1 s for a nudge up to 1.0 s for a big hit. Needs Contact Physics.

options.label: Custom spins: exit mistakes
options.description: Only with AI spins: Custom. Throttle mistakes on corner exit: the AI gets on the throttle early and the rear steps out. More = 30 % bigger, up to 32 deg. Lots = 60 %, up to 42 (game: 23).

options.label: Custom spins: steering correction
options.description: Only with AI spins: Custom. How hard the AI fights a slide: its steering gains at 75 or 50 %. Weaker = slides are caught later. The AI still turns into corners as fast as in the game.

options.label: Custom spins: traction control
options.description: Only with AI spins: Custom. Scales the AI's traction control to half or off. Less = more wheelspin on corner exit.

options.label: Custom spins: when they lift off
options.description: Only with AI spins: Custom. How far into a slide the AI starts lifting off the throttle (the game's value is 0.5). Higher = it keeps full throttle deeper into a slide.

options.label: Custom spins: when they lose the car
options.description: Only with AI spins: Custom. The slide angle at which the AI gives up and spins (the game's value is 23 degrees). Smaller = it spins sooner.

options.label: Custom spins: reaction to slides
options.description: Only with AI spins: Custom. When an AI car starts to slide, its steering and throttle stay put this long before it reacts, so some slides become spins. The game reacts at once.

options.label: Damage: speed with a damaged car
options.description: How much a damaged AI car slows down for corners and braking. Pushing = half the game's slowdown, Flat out = a quarter. Both also raise the speed limit with a puncture.
